_help: Meeting Eleanor in the museum reading room (recruits her).

already.speaker: eleanor
already.line: I've packed my notebooks twice already. Tell me we leave soon.

first.speaker: eleanor
first.line: You're the one asking about Akmentar. I heard every word through the Professor's door.

choices.label: Invite her along
choices.line: Then you heard I need an Egyptologist. Come with us.

choices.label: Ask what she knows
choices.line: What do you know about Akmentar that he doesn't?

choices.label: Leave
choices.line: Sorry to have bothered you, miss.

knows.speaker: eleanor
knows.line: Three papyri in our own basement name a king who appears on no list. Someone went to a great deal of trouble to forget him.

choices.label: Invite her along
choices.line: Then come and help me find him.

terms.speaker: eleanor
terms.line: On one condition. Whatever we find, I publish it, under my own name.

choices.label: Promise
choices.line: Your name, your work. You have my word.

choices.label: Make no promises
choices.line: Let's find it first, then argue about the credit.

joined.speaker: eleanor
joined.line: Then I'm coming. I'll fetch my things before the Professor finds out.

joined_cool.speaker: eleanor
joined_cool.line: Fine. But I'm keeping my own notes.
